text:
jess_peopleops: Heads up — planning to travel to Copenhagen for 6 weeks (May 10–Jun 20). Do I need to declare it? Will my WFH stipend / equipment shipping change? Also worried about tax nexus — can ops flag anything? :denmark:

mike_eng: Quick Q — will you be on EU hours while there? Need to know for oncall handoffs. Also do you want a spare charger shipped?

jess_peopleops: Yes EU hours mostly (will overlap with PST mornings). Laptop stays with me, maybe need a charger shipped. Main things: stipend proration and whether payroll needs a flag.

elena_finance: @jess_peopleops please declare in the portal. Stipend policy: visits >30 days generally continue full monthly WFH stipend; under 30 days we prorate. 6 weeks => full stipend. Shipping: if a company-owned asset crosses customs we need asset-crossing paperwork. I'll tag infra/payroll.

luca_legal: Quick legal note: tax nexus typically requires longer presence (183-day threshold) but countries vary. Denmark at 6 weeks usually isn't a nexus event. If you're meeting customers or entering into contracts locally, escalate. We should still log it with our payroll vendor.

sam_ops: Steps to make this smooth:
1) Submit temporary remote work form: https://intranet.company.com/people-ops/declare
2) Attach travel dates and purpose
3) If equipment crosses borders, open an asset-shipping ticket with inventory tag
I'll cc payroll after step 1.

tax_bot: Payroll vendor quick-check: no immediate nexus flag for Denmark under our 90d policy. Reference: https://wiki.redwood/peopleops/tax-nexus#country-guidance

elena_finance: Also confirm benefits coverage while abroad (medical). If you need emergency assistance numbers, ping benefits@redwood. I'll open a payroll review ticket once you submit the form.

jess_peopleops: Form submitted with dates and purpose, attached travel itinerary. @elena_finance @luca_legal tagging for follow-ups. @sam_ops can you confirm shipping policy — charger might cross for a week or two.

sam_ops: Charger crossing is low-risk but still file the physical asset crossing form so customs docs are ready. I'll create a shipping ticket and mark it non-commercial.

mike_eng: Can you add a calendar block for overlap so we know when to do oncall handoffs?

jess_peopleops: Done — created daily overlap 9–11 PT (18–20 CET) and posted an event in the team calendar.

luca_legal: Friendly reminder: do not sign any local vendor contracts while on short-term remote. If you have recurring customer commitments that create local revenue, loop legal. Keep receipts for any reimbursable expenses.

elena_finance: Confirmed internally: stipend will not be reduced for the 6-week period. Payroll vendor will not change your withholding. I'll DM the payroll ticket ID here when it's created.

tax_bot: payroll-ticket: #PR-48291 created (vendor review). Expected vendor response in 2–3 business days.

jess_peopleops: Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
